description: This file defines a class `Xml` that extends `BaseReader`, serving as a specialized reader for SpreadsheetML (XML schema for Microsoft Office Excel 2003). It includes methods for reading, validating, and parsing SpreadsheetML files to extract worksheet names, worksheet information, and to load the spreadsheet data into a `Spreadsheet` object. The class handles XML namespace processing, style parsing, cell data extraction, and worksheet configuration, making it central to importing Excel files in XML format within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Xml
classes.description: A class for reading SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML format) files, capable of loading worksheets, parsing styles, and importing data into a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: xmlMappings
methods.description: Returns an array of style mapping definitions for fill and border styles.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Determines if a given file can be read as SpreadsheetML by checking for specific XML namespace signatures.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Extracts and returns the list of worksheet names from a given SpreadsheetML file without loading the entire spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides metadata about worksheets such as name, last column, total rows, and columns, without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromString
methods.description: Creates and returns a Spreadsheet object from a string containing SpreadsheetML data.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet from a file, returning a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads data from a file or string into an existing Spreadsheet object, with options for content vs filename.

methods.name: parseCellComment
methods.description: Parses comment data from a cell and attaches it to the active sheet in the Spreadsheet.

methods.name: parseRichText
methods.description: Creates a RichText object from annotation string.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Helper to retrieve attributes of a SimpleXMLElement, returning an empty XML element if input is null.
